clips.title: The story
paras: On Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff, Holt Thunderhorn trains tauren hunters for the Horde. He teaches tracking and survival, and points hunters toward specialized trials across Mulgore and beyond.

Holt Thunderhorn trains hunters for the Horde on Hunter Rise, above the plains of Mulgore. He teaches ranged combat, tracking, and survival. Like other elders of his craft, he guides young tauren as they move from roaming hunters to disciplined defenders of their new capital.
